_note: Pods for the lander (sim/pods.gd, sim/systems/pod_system.gd). A module with 'pod_mount' (the lander bay) carries one pod, ship.pod, which counts toward the ship's stats as a module would: cargo_t, fuel_t, berths, payload_t, mass_t (dry). No pod key means the default pod. Pods are fitted at a shipyard (price; the old pod is taken back at trade_in of its price) and can be dropped on site, holding what you leave in them (cargo, or propellant in a tank pod), and picked up again later by anyone's lander: they stay where they are, in the saved game, until collected. 'look' is for the view (view/flight/kestrel.gd).
